E2_attention_logit_precision_mechanism.dispatch_confirmation: flash arm run under JAMMI_KERNELS_STRICT=1 with nothing disabled produced the IDENTICAL loss (470070.7) as the default run -- Strict mode errors loudly on any failed predicate anywhere in the cascade, so this rules out a silent K2 fallback (guide 3.5, zero-dispatch-is-RED). Independently, disabling ONLY attention_block_fused (never reached in the flash cascade) reproduced the SAME loss with disabled_fired=[], confirming attention_block_flash preempted it.
E2_attention_logit_precision_mechanism.verdict: H2 CONFIRMED, both bands: the SAME decomposed eager-attention path (rope fused, softmax/scores bf16-native) differing ONLY in JAMMI_ROUND5_UPCAST_SCORES improves boundary[1-18].cos 0.354->0.592 and qkv[0-18].cos 0.406->0.710 (the pervasive shared-arm divergence) AND qkv[19-27].cos 0.924->0.973 (round 4's originally-localized band). The REAL FlashAttention-2 arm (flash) does even better on the pervasive band (boundary[1-18].cos=0.7496, qkv[0-18].cos=0.8523, best of every arm tested including jammi's own production fused arm) and has the LOWEST all-84 relerr (0.6128) of any bf16 arm. Keeping attention logits/softmax in F32 -- not RopeFused's own math -- is the mechanism.

E3_inherent_to_bf16_vs_jammi_defect.description: Aggregate proxy (full per-layer register_full_backward_hook torch table NOT built within this round's time budget -- see 'incomplete' below). torch's OWN bf16-vs-f32 ceiling, computed from ALREADY-VALIDATED torch reference runs (torch_finetune_step.py / torch_grad_oracle.py legs at /root/go5 on jammi-a100, independent of any jammi code; b4-s128, seed 42, rank16/alpha32/target=[Wqkv,Wo,Wi]), cosine of the FULL concatenated trainable LoRA-gradient vector (7,196,672 params).
E3_inherent_to_bf16_vs_jammi_defect.caveat: torch's go5 legs and this round's jammi round5_out legs load DIFFERENT shared LoRA weight files (different seeding runs) and measure a DIFFERENT metric (full trainable-gradient cosine vs per-layer activation-gradient cosine) -- not directly cross-comparable point-for-point. This is a proxy answer, not the full E3 table the dispatch specified.
E3_inherent_to_bf16_vs_jammi_defect.reasoning: torch's own production bf16 attention path (SDPA -> FlashAttention-2 on sm80, per sdp_utils.cpp's priority_order) reaches only cos=0.817 vs its own F32 truth -- NOT 0.99+. jammi's flash arm (E2, same underlying FA2 mechanism, real vendored kernel) lands in a comparable range (boundary[1-18].cos=0.75, qkv[0-18].cos=0.85). This suggests the RESIDUAL divergence after fixing the F32-logits mechanism is substantially INHERENT to bf16 LoRA fine-tuning at this checkpoint/scale, not a further jammi defect -- while the GAP BETWEEN jammi's non-FA2 arms (fused/shared, cos 0.35-0.74 in the same zone) and jammi's FA2 arm / torch's own bf16 ceiling (cos 0.75-0.92) IS jammi-specific and IS what the F32-logits mechanism (E2) closes.
E3_inherent_to_bf16_vs_jammi_defect.incomplete: The full 28-layer torch register_full_backward_hook boundary/qkv table (torch bf16-sdpa and torch f32, same checkpoint/LoRA/seed/batch as E2's jammi legs, for a row-by-row comparison against the E2 table) was NOT built -- deprioritized against E2/E1 given the round's time budget.
